page: City page: B2B lead generation Paris (/b2b-lead-generation-paris)

items.question: Does Myntmore have an office in Paris?
items.answer: No. Myntmore's only office is in BKC, Mumbai, and every engagement runs remotely. Companies selling to Paris work with us over calls, a shared dashboard and a weekly report, the same way our other clients do. This page describes the Paris market we reach, not a local branch.

items.question: Who is lead generation for Paris built for?
items.answer: B2B companies that want meetings with Paris buyers, mainly pharma, cosmetics, aerospace and SaaS companies. That includes firms based there and Indian or international companies selling into France. If your buyers are businesses, not consumers, the same system adapts to your ICP.

items.question: We are an Indian company that wants clients in Paris. Can you help?
items.answer: Yes. We build separate sending domains so your main domain is never at risk, write copy for buyers in Paris and send in their working hours. Paris is 3.5 hours behind India in summer and 4.5 hours in winter, so meetings fit the Indian afternoon. Campaigns go live within 18 days of kickoff.

items.question: Is cold email allowed for Paris buyers?
items.answer: France applies GDPR, and its regulator, the CNIL, accepts B2B email prospecting without prior consent when the message relates to the recipient's job, they are told how their data is used, and they can opt out easily. This is general information, not legal advice.

items.question: How quickly can we expect meetings to start?
items.answer: Campaigns go live within 18 days of kickoff, and most clients see their first qualified conversations in weeks 3 to 4. The first two weeks go into ICP mapping, list building, sending domains with warm-up, and copy. Meeting volume usually becomes consistent by weeks 6 to 8, once messaging is tuned on real replies.

items.question: What does pricing look like?
items.answer: We work on a monthly retainer with a 3-month minimum, which covers setup and enough sending to judge results. After that it runs month to month with 30 days' notice, with no annual contract. We don't publish a price list; we share a quote after a free GTM audit call, once we know which channels you need.
